title: Publish the immutable candidate recovery escrow
description:
Every publishable byte and recovery parent is durably published once in an immutable public candidate prerelease bound to the protected annotated candidate tag before final authorization can become irreversible.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: An isolated candidate-escrow protected job accepts only candidate_root_artifact_id, authenticates the full producer/event/freeze chain, creates or resumes the exact matching draft on the protected annotated candidate tag, and uploads native/source/MCP/OCI candidates, checksums, SPDX/SBOMs, attestations, candidate root, frozen release metadata, and a complete compact evidence/recovery bundle. No final v1 channel is touched.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each draft asset upload records numeric release/asset ID, canonical URL, size and GitHub digest and verifies downloaded bytes against root subject digests. Duplicate/mismatched draft, missing byte/parent, renamed asset, incomplete upload, source change, or any replacement fails before publish; matching incomplete draft recovery only appends the exact missing asset.
- [hard] REQ-03: After the full set verifies, the job publishes it once as a prerelease. Read-only verification requires the expected candidate tag/SHA, `prerelease:true`, immutable status, release attestation, exact release ID/URL and asset IDs/digests, and proves published assets/tag reject edit/delete/replace by available automation identities.
- [hard] REQ-04: The published candidate prerelease is an intentional public candidate boundary and may remain visible permanently. Public npm 1.0.0, v1.0.0 tag/final GitHub Release, and GHCR :1.0.0 remain absent. After publication no workflow receives authority to mutate/delete this escrow; failure or escrow loss/mismatch before final tag abandons the candidate and requires a new freeze/tag.
- [hard] REQ-05: Success uploads an escrow-completed ledger artifact but authority is the immutable candidate release/tag/attestation itself. The record contains release ID/URL, asset IDs/digests, root digest, candidate tag/SHA and release-attestation identity; an Actions 410 cannot erase escrow.

## Notes

Blast radius: one protected draft upload/publish operation and one intentional public immutable candidate prerelease; no npm, GHCR v1, final tag, or final GitHub Release mutation.
